The boundary of Д9 (a), measured by my probe TV03r. The reading takes the executor of a project as its journal was created: the PROJECT_CREATED first line, which the page marks and which the README calls the project's executor. A server that rewrites only the later lines of a scripted project to claude-cli at exit (its runs) and keeps the created line stays green. No real run happens in it: the trap marker is not set, and a start of the program at shutdown is red (TV02, M01p). Д7, three details of the built form. (a) The removal's error names its place, 'at the removal of the folder of the test', and not 'at line ? of the spec'. The gate's FX1 measured '?': the stack of a recursive removal holds no frame of the spec within V8's ten frames. To do this, withoutPath got an optional place argument; every other call is unchanged. (b) inFolders has no finally any more. A throw in a finally is refused by eslint's no-unsafe-finally, so the form is the kit's withBrowser and withStand: the body, then the removal, then the throw. A flag keeps the case where the body throws null or undefined. (c) The removal's error is attached as cleanupError, the kit's convention. An earlier cleanupError on the body's error (the kit's stop failure) is kept on the removal's error, not lost. The runner's TAP reporter does not print cleanupError. The spec reporter prints it, and with no path (TF1, checked).
